enforced_by: the copywriter and the video teardown read it; nothing refuses an unknown value
note: One list per dial — humour, delivery style, register, pacing, reference world, avoid; the asset is the dial.

rows.name: none
rows.what: No joke anywhere. The piece is played straight from the first frame to the last.

extra.when: Any beat carrying proof, the offer or the ask; any room whose subject is pain, money, health or loss; any piece whose speaker has to be believed more than liked.

rows.name: dry
rows.what: A true thing said flat, with the funny part left for the viewer to find. Nothing in the delivery signals that a joke happened.

extra.when: Rooms that prize being unimpressed; the beats where an annoyance is admitted rather than performed.

rows.name: wry
rows.what: The speaker is in on it — a half-smile inside the line, an acknowledgement that the situation is ridiculous and they are still standing in it.

extra.when: Long-running annoyances the room has made peace with; the turn out of a failed-solutions beat.

rows.name: self-deprecating
rows.what: The speaker is the target. It buys the right to make a claim afterwards, because the worst has already been admitted by the person making it.

extra.when: Openings into rooms that distrust advertising voice; identification beats; any beat immediately before a hard claim.

rows.name: observational
rows.what: The joke is a detail out of the room's own daily life, named precisely enough that the recognition is the laugh.

extra.when: Identification and problem beats, where being seen matters more than being amused.

rows.name: absurd
rows.what: The premise itself is impossible and it is played completely straight.

extra.when: Rooms that already know the category cold and will not sit through another straight opening.

rows.name: broad
rows.what: The joke is loud, physical and unmissable. Nobody has to work for it.

extra.when: Placements with no shared in-words to rely on; the widest reach the piece is bought for.
